If this migration is ever re-run (db:migrate:redo, or a partially-migrated environment where the table already exists with imported topic/post associations), all topic_embed rows are silently dropped, orphaning every imported topic from its source URL so feed polling re-imports duplicates and embed lookups 404.

However, under normal Rails migration semantics, this migration is applied once (tracked in `schema_migrations`), and `db:migrate:redo` rolls back before re-applying, so the described “silent drop on re-run”/data loss scenario requires an abnormal state (e.g., the table exists but the migration is considered pending).
